decisions.reason: This yogurt remains very close to the firm's established dairy know-how and had early external validation, so management would expect strong ability to refine it and only a low risk of withdrawal.

The semi-hard cheese wheel fits directly with the firm's core cheese capabilities, making learning and incremental improvement feasible, though its lower visibility leaves some moderate portfolio risk.

The spicy cheese line still builds on familiar cheese-making and flavor-extension knowledge, but after the earlier withdrawal of a related flavored cheese product management would watch it more critically and keep some rationalisation risk.
The mild creamy soft cheese extends the cheese range in a familiar and commercially understandable direction, so the firm is likely to keep developing it rather than exit quickly.

Although related to existing cheese expertise, washed-rind soft cheese is the most demanding in process control and market acceptance, so management is likely to reallocate resources if it has not clearly proven itself by now.
